verdict.rationale: Gram documents hosted MCP servers. Developers point Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot at one URL. The Control Plane either generates the server from OpenAPI or TypeScript Functions or creates a proxy endpoint in front of an upstream remote MCP server, and teams connect to that endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the user runs no infrastructure (hosting is implied rather than stated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting a client to a hosted URL.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure

citations.quote: Point Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot at one URL.
The Control Plane creates an endpoint that proxies the upstream, and the team connects to that endpoint instead.
the Control Plane generates the server itself from a first-party source: an OpenAPI document or a TypeScript Functions project.
the raw execution log for every tool call the platform observes across hosted MCP servers
